title: Ample powers supply a section of an ideal near a point outside its zero set
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $\mathcal M$ an ample invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ a quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] ideal sheaf. If $y\notin V(\mathcal J)$, there are $n>0$ and $u\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal J\mathcal M^{\otimes n})$ with $y\in Y_u$ (viewing $u$ also as a section of $\mathcal M^{\otimes n}$).

source.place: Properties Proposition 01Q3 (properties-proposition-characterize-ample), equivalence of (1) and (6), ideal-sheaf global generation

proof.text: Choose d>0, s and the affine open U containing y from ampleness. Use the proved bridge and the source generatesAt_iff_mem_compl_support to identify U with the zero-locus complement of homOfGlobalSection s. The source isFreeGenerator_app_one_of_le makes s a free generator on U.
The Mathlib mem_support_iff_of_mem and mem_zeroLocus_iff give a in J.ideal(U) with y in D(a). The proved source range_toModulesι_app gives t in Gamma(J.toModules,U) with image a.

Ample separatedness gives Y.IsSeparated. The structure modules are quasi-coherent; the source isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion and isQuasicoherent_kernel prove quasi-coherence of J.toModules, its defining kernel (no local Noetherian hypothesis). Apply denominator clearing over the terminal affine scheme: obtain m and v restricting to t tensor s^m.

Apply mulTensorPowSection with exponent 1 to v. Its restriction is t tensor s^(m+1). Transport along tensorPowMulIso to degree n=d*(m+1)>0, then apply the ideal inclusion tensored with identity and the left unitor. Naturality and the source tensor section formulas give u restricted to U equal to a times the transported generator s^(m+1).

Tensor powers of a free generator, and its image under an isomorphism, are free generators. Since y lies in D(a), generatesAt_of_mem_basicOpen gives local generation of u; the proved bridge gives y in nonvanishingLocus u.

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 01Q3 (properties-proposition-characterize-ample), the part (1) => (5) => (6) of its proof specialized to F = J and the point y: choose s in Gamma(Y, M^d) with y in Y_s affine (definition 01PS); pick f in J(Y_s) not in p_y (zero set of a quasi-coherent ideal on an affine); Y is separated (09MP); Lemma 01PW (the Lean-closed lem-pc-section-clearing-denominators, with Y_s identified with the complement of Z(s)) gives u' in Gamma(Y, J (x) M^{dm}) restricting to f s^m; u = mu(u' (x) s) lies in Gamma(Y, J M^{d(m+1)}) and its germ at y is f_y times a basis. Statement kept (the hypothesis 'quasi-compact' is redundant, ampleness includes it). No new nodes; no slopmaster2 declaration states the item. The source deduces separatedness from the open immersion into Proj (01Q1); the split uses 09MP instead, which is the same fact by a shorter route. A factor s is multiplied in to make n = d(m+1) > 0 since 01PW may return m = 0.
